heading: Comparable stores delivered revenue growth of +3.5M in June 2026.
paragraphs: Revenue increased by +3.5M across the comparable store population.
Transactions rose by +244.0K, alongside a retail price change of +0.27.
Quantity declined by -238.5K, indicating fewer units sold despite higher revenue.
No other positive volume movement is visible in the supplied evidence beyond transactions growth.
Review the June 2026 comparable-store results against prior periods to confirm whether revenue growth of +3.5M is being sustained by transactions of +244.0K and retail price change of +0.27.
Investigate where the quantity decline of -238.5K is concentrated within the comparable store population.
Monitor whether revenue growth of +3.5M continues alongside lower quantity and higher transactions in future monthly updates.
